result.finding: HTTP/REST is the only communication protocol used. The application exposes HTTP endpoints via Spring MVC (@Controller, @GetMapping, @PostMapping) on port 8080. It communicates with Oracle DB via JDBC over TCP (port 1521). No gRPC, message queues, WebSockets, or other protocols detected.
evidence: Spring MVC @Controller with @GetMapping/@PostMapping annotations found in 3 controllers (HomeController, DetailController, PhotoFileController)
HomeController.uploadPhotos() uses @ResponseBody returning JSON — hybrid REST endpoint
PhotoFileController.servePhoto() returns binary image data over HTTP
JDBC connection to Oracle DB via spring.datasource.url=jdbc:oracle:thin:@oracle-db:1521/FREEPDB1
No gRPC .proto files found, no Kafka/RabbitMQ dependencies, no WebSocket annotations
values: JDBC/TCP — outbound to Oracle DB on port 1521
Protocols NOT used: gRPC, WebSocket, Kafka, RabbitMQ, AMQP
